answer: Mutual Witness Summits. Agents must periodically co-sign a shared state digest with peers they actually transact with; each round randomly partitions the network into small groups that must reach agreement under a gale of verification traffic. Forgery requires the attacker to seed fake peers and sustain real coordination across every partition, since a lone identity in a meadow of honest peers cannot produce matching digests. Cost: one live co-signer per identity per round, scaling linearly with sock-puppet count.
